763	    // MARK: - The read, memoised
764	
765	    private struct Key: Hashable {
766	        let path: String
767	        let size: UInt64
768	        let modified: Date
769	        let need: [ClosedRange<Int>]
770	        let width: Int
771	        let height: Int
772	    }
773	
774	    private struct Point {
775	        let value: (Double, Double)?
776	    }
777	
778	    private static let lock = NSLock()
779	    private static var memo: [Key: Point] = [:]
780	    private static let memoLimit = 64
781	
782	    /// The mean centroid over the found frames minus `(w/2, h/2)`, or nil when no frame is
783	    /// found or the pack cannot be read. Any thread; memoised on the pack file's path, size and
784	    /// modification date, the need and the media's size.
785	    static func focus(_ inputs: Inputs) -> (Double, Double)? {
786	        let attributes = try? FileManager.default.attributesOfItem(atPath: inputs.pack.path)
787	        let key = (attributes?[.size] as? NSNumber).flatMap { size in
788	            (attributes?[.modificationDate] as? Date).map { modified in
789	                Key(
790	                    path: inputs.pack.standardizedFileURL.path, size: size.uint64Value,
791	                    modified: modified, need: inputs.need, width: inputs.mediaWidth,
792	                    height: inputs.mediaHeight)
793	            }
794	        }
795	        if let key {
796	            lock.lock()
797	            let hit = memo[key]
798	            lock.unlock()
799	            if let hit { return hit.value }
800	        }
801	        var value: (Double, Double)?
802	        if let pack = try? MaskPack(contentsOf: inputs.pack),
803	            let point = (try? CutoutStatus.centroid(
804	                pack: pack, need: inputs.need, coverage: inputs.coverage,
805	                mediaWidth: inputs.mediaWidth, mediaHeight: inputs.mediaHeight)) ?? nil
806	        {
807	            value = (
808	                Double(point.x) - Double(inputs.mediaWidth) / 2,
809	                Double(point.y) - Double(inputs.mediaHeight) / 2
810	            )
811	        }
812	        if let key {
813	            lock.lock()
814	            if memo.count >= memoLimit { memo.removeAll() }
815	            memo[key] = Point(value: value)
816	            lock.unlock()
817	        }
818	        return value
819	    }
820	}

951	/// Who is the camera and who the screen for the menu (CO-66).
952	enum CameraLayoutRoles {
953	    /// The track a recording's camera lands on (`RecordingLanding`).
954	    static let cameraTrackName = "Camera"
955	
956	    /// Two selected picture clips on different tracks: the front one is the
957	    /// camera and the other the screen. One: it is the camera and the core
958	    /// finds the screen. None: the clip at the playhead on the front-most
959	    /// track named "Camera". nil when that yields no camera containing the
960	    /// playhead.
961	    static func roles(selected: [ClipSnapshot], playhead: Ticks, in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot)
962	        -> (camera: UInt32, screen: UInt32?)?
963	    {
964	        let picture = { (clip: ClipSnapshot) in
965	            clip.video != nil && snapshot.sourceSize(of: clip) != nil
966	        }
967	        let plays = { (clip: ClipSnapshot) in clip.start <= playhead && playhead < clip.end }
968	        switch selected.count {
969	        case 2:
970	            guard selected.allSatisfy(picture),
971	                let a = snapshot.trackIndex(of: selected[0].track),
972	                let b = snapshot.trackIndex(of: selected[1].track), a != b
973	            else { return nil }
974	            let (camera, screen) = a > b ? (selected[0], selected[1]) : (selected[1], selected[0])
975	            return plays(camera) ? (camera.id, screen.id) : nil
976	        case 1:
977	            let camera = selected[0]
978	            return picture(camera) && plays(camera) ? (camera.id, nil) : nil
979	        case 0:
980	            guard let track = snapshot.tracks.last(where: { $0.name == cameraTrackName }),
981	                let camera = snapshot.clips.first(where: {
982	                    $0.track == track.id && plays($0) && picture($0)
983	                })
984	            else { return nil }
985	            return (camera.id, nil)
986	        default:
987	            return nil
988	        }
989	    }
990	}

4	/// settings and their remembered keys, the selected clips' cursor files found and read, and
5	/// `plan_zooms` asked of the core through `ReelCursor` (this file names no `rc_*`, CJ-8 (l))
6	/// with its answer read into ops. Both doors — Clip ▸ Auto Zoom… (`AutoZoomSheetController`)

9	/// What the sheet sets (CU-70's defaults). `typing` is never remembered: it is on whenever the
10	/// files hold typing (CU-76). `motionBlur` is the shutter the planned clips are given (spec §11
11	/// CU-118 (c)): the owner's 50 % by default, 0 for none.
12	struct AutoZoomSettings: Equatable {
13	    var zoom = 2.0, lead = 0.6, stay = 2.5
14	    var follow = true, typing = true, replace = false
15	    var motionBlur = 0.5
16	
17	    static let zoomRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 1.25...4
18	    static let leadRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 0.2...2.0
19	    static let stayRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 0.5...10.0
20	
21	    static let zoomKey = "FrameJobAutoZoomZoom"
22	    static let leadKey = "FrameJobAutoZoomLead"
23	    static let stayKey = "FrameJobAutoZoomStay"
24	    static let followKey = "FrameJobAutoZoomFollow"
25	    static let replaceKey = "FrameJobAutoZoomReplace"
26	    /// The sheet's "Motion blur" checkbox, remembered as a Bool: on is `motionBlurShutter`, off 0.
27	    static let motionBlurKey = "FrameJobAutoZoomMotionBlur"
28	    /// The shutter "Motion blur" sets when on (the owner's answer, 2026-11-01: a 180° shutter).
29	    static let motionBlurShutter = 0.5
30	
31	    /// The remembered values, each clamped into its range; the default for a key not stored.
32	    /// Read through `double(forKey:)` and `bool(forKey:)`, so a launch argument's string
33	    /// (`-FrameJobAutoZoomLead 1`) reads as its number.
34	    static func remembered(_ d: UserDefaults) -> AutoZoomSettings {
35	        var s = AutoZoomSettings()
36	        func number(_ key: String, _ range: ClosedRange<Double>, _ value: inout Double) {
37	            guard d.object(forKey: key) != nil else { return }
38	            let v = d.double(forKey: key)
39	            if v.isFinite, v > 0 { value = min(max(v, range.lowerBound), range.upperBound) }
40	        }
41	        number(zoomKey, zoomRange, &s.zoom)
42	        number(leadKey, leadRange, &s.lead)
43	        number(stayKey, stayRange, &s.stay)
44	        if d.object(forKey: followKey) != nil { s.follow = d.bool(forKey: followKey) }
45	        if d.object(forKey: replaceKey) != nil { s.replace = d.bool(forKey: replaceKey) }
46	        if d.object(forKey: motionBlurKey) != nil {
47	            s.motionBlur = d.bool(forKey: motionBlurKey) ? motionBlurShutter : 0
48	        }
49	        return s
50	    }

52	    /// Writes only the keys whose value differs from `opened`'s, so a sheet whose controls
53	    /// were not changed writes nothing (mcp.py's DEFAULTS MOVED guard); `typing` never.
54	    func remember(changedFrom opened: AutoZoomSettings, in d: UserDefaults) {
55	        if zoom != opened.zoom { d.set(zoom, forKey: Self.zoomKey) }
56	        if lead != opened.lead { d.set(lead, forKey: Self.leadKey) }
57	        if stay != opened.stay { d.set(stay, forKey: Self.stayKey) }
58	        if follow != opened.follow { d.set(follow, forKey: Self.followKey) }
59	        if replace != opened.replace { d.set(replace, forKey: Self.replaceKey) }
60	        if motionBlur != opened.motionBlur { d.set(motionBlur > 0, forKey: Self.motionBlurKey) }
61	    }
62	}

95	    static func cursorFiles(_ clips: [ClipSnapshot], in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot) throws
96	        -> [UInt32: URL]
97	    {

99	        for clip in clips {
100	            guard case .media(let id, _, _) = clip.source, let media = snapshot.media(id) else {

149	    /// `plan_zooms`' request JSON for `clips` (container ticks `from`/`to`, nil for none).

152	    ) -> String {
153	        var args: [String: Any] = [
154	            "clips": clips.map { Int($0) }, "zoom": settings.zoom, "lead": settings.lead,
155	            "stay": settings.stay, "follow": settings.follow, "typing": settings.typing,
156	            "replace": settings.replace,
157	        ]
158	        if let from { args["from"] = from }
159	        if let to { args["to"] = to }

164	    /// Asks the core for the plan over `clips` of `project` (the edited one, so inside a nest
165	    /// the nest's), one track per clip; throws the core's sentence as a `Refusal`.
166	    static func plan(
167	        _ clips: [ClipSnapshot], tracks: [UInt32: ReelCursor], project: ReelProject,
168	        settings: AutoZoomSettings, from: Ticks?, to: Ticks?
169	    ) throws -> AutoZoomPlan {
170	        var ordered: [ReelCursor] = []
171	        for clip in clips {
172	            guard case .media(let id, _, _) = clip.source, let track = tracks[id] else {
173	                throw Refusal(message: "Clip \(clip.id)'s cursor file was not read.")
174	            }
175	            ordered.append(track)
176	        }
177	        let text: String
178	        do {
179	            text = try ReelCursor.query(
180	                request(clips.map(\.id), settings: settings, from: from, to: to),
181	                tracks: ordered, project: project)
182	        } catch {
183	            let reason = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
184	            throw Refusal(message: sentence(reason))
185	        }
186	        guard let answer = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(text.utf8))
187	            as? [String: Any]
188	        else { throw Refusal(message: "Auto Zoom's plan could not be read.") }
189	        var ops = try ((answer["ops"] as? [[String: Any]]) ?? []).map(op)
190	        func count(_ key: String) -> Int { (answer[key] as? NSNumber)?.intValue ?? 0 }
191	        let actions = (answer["actions"] as? [[String: Any]]) ?? []
192	        let blurred = unblurred(actions, in: project.snapshot)
193	        if settings.motionBlur > 0, !blurred.isEmpty {
194	            ops.append(
195	                .setVideo(clips: blurred, patch: VideoPatch(motionBlur: settings.motionBlur)))
196	        }
197	        return AutoZoomPlan(
198	            ops: ops, visits: count("visits"), added: count("added"),
199	            replaced: count("replaced"), dropped: count("dropped"),
200	            closedAtCut: count("closed_at_cut"), basesSet: count("bases_set"),
201	            actions: actions, blurred: settings.motionBlur > 0 ? blurred.count : 0)
202	    }

204	    /// The distinct clips the planned actions name, in first-named order, whose BASE
205	    /// `video.motion_blur` is 0 (CU-118 (c)): a clip that already has a shutter keeps it.
206	    private static func unblurred(_ actions: [[String: Any]], in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot)
207	        -> [UInt32]
208	    {
209	        var clips: [UInt32] = []
210	        for action in actions {
211	            guard let id = (action["clip"] as? NSNumber)?.uint32Value, !clips.contains(id),
212	                let clip = snapshot.clip(id), (clip.video?.motionBlur ?? 0) <= 0
213	            else { continue }
214	            clips.append(id)
215	        }
216	        return clips
217	    }

219	    /// The core's lowercase sentence as one a person reads: capitalised, with a full stop.
220	    static func sentence(_ core: String) -> String {
221	        guard let first = core.first else { return core }
222	        let text = first.uppercased() + core.dropFirst()
223	        return text.hasSuffix(".") ? text : text + "."
224	    }

226	    /// One op of the answer, through `ReelOps.swift`'s factories.
227	    private static func op(_ o: [String: Any]) throws -> ReelOp {
228	        func id(_ key: String) -> UInt32 { (o[key] as? NSNumber)?.uint32Value ?? 0 }
229	        func ticks(_ key: String) -> Ticks { (o[key] as? NSNumber)?.int64Value ?? 0 }
230	        switch o["op"] as? String {
231	        case "remove_action":
232	            return .removeAction(clip: id("clip"), action: id("action"))
233	        case "set_video":
234	            let clips = ((o["clips"] as? [NSNumber]) ?? []).map(\.uint32Value)
235	            return .setVideoRaw(clips: clips, patch: o["patch"] ?? [String: Any]())
236	        case "add_zoom_action":
237	            return .addZoomActionRaw(
238	                clip: id("clip"), at: ticks("at"), duration: ticks("duration"),
239	                region: o["region"] ?? NSNull(),
240	                fit: (o["fit"] as? String).flatMap(ZoomFit.init(rawValue:)),
241	                curve: (o["curve"] as? String).flatMap(Curve.init(rawValue:)))
242	        default:
243	            throw Refusal(message: "Auto Zoom's plan named an op it does not make.")
244	        }
245	    }

522	/// Add Shortcut Overlays' Swift half (road map "creator-jobs" CU8, spec §11 CU-80…CU-84): the
523	/// settings, the bundled `keyboard-keys` template and the module rule (CU-81), and
524	/// `plan_overlays` asked of the core through `ReelCursor` (this file names no `rc_*`, CJ-8 (l))

527	/// (`AgentServer+ShortcutOverlays.swift`) — place through `prepared`. The cursor files are

529	
530	/// What a run places with (CU-80's defaults; the owner's answer: bottom, dark). Nothing is
531	/// remembered: the menu item has no sheet to change it.
532	struct ShortcutOverlaySettings: Equatable {
533	    var duration = 1.5
534	    var position = "bottom"
535	    var theme = "dark"

537	    static let durationRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 0.5...10
538	    static let positions = ["bottom", "center", "top"]

542	/// `plan_overlays`' answer: the ops in the core's order and its counts.
543	struct ShortcutOverlayPlan {
544	    let ops: [ReelOp]
545	    let added, dropped, merged: Int
546	    let track: UInt32
547	    let newTrack: Bool
548	    let overlays: [[String: Any]]
549	}
550	
551	enum ShortcutOverlays {
552	    /// The undo step's name, both doors.
553	    static let actionName = "Add Shortcut Overlays"
554	    /// The bundled template the overlays are drawn by.
555	    static let templateName = "keyboard-keys"
556	
557	    /// What a run that placed nothing says (CU-84).
558	    static let nothingSentence =
559	        "No shortcut was recorded in the selected clips' played windows, so nothing was added."
560	
561	    /// What a run that dropped `n` presses says (CU-80).
562	    static func droppedSentence(_ n: Int) -> String {
563	        n == 1
564	            ? "1 shortcut came too close to show."
565	            : "\(n) shortcuts came too close to show."
566	    }
567	
568	    /// The documents a menu run is reading cursor files for. Main only.
569	    private static var pending: Set<ObjectIdentifier> = []
570	
571	    static func isPending(_ document: ProjectDocument) -> Bool {
572	        pending.contains(ObjectIdentifier(document))
573	    }
574	
575	    static func setPending(_ document: ProjectDocument, _ on: Bool) {
576	        if on {
577	            pending.insert(ObjectIdentifier(document))
578	        } else {
579	            pending.remove(ObjectIdentifier(document))
580	        }
581	    }
582	
583	    /// The bundled `keyboard-keys.js`: its URL, its bytes and the schema
584	    /// `GraphicTemplateLibrary` compiled from it. Main (the library's first read).
585	    static func template() throws -> (url: URL, bytes: Data, schema: [String: Any]) {
586	        guard let found = GraphicTemplateLibrary.shared.entry(named: templateName) else {
587	            throw AutoZoom.Refusal(
588	                message: "The bundled \(templateName) template is missing from this build.")
589	        }
590	        guard case .compiled(_, _, _, let schema) = found.entry,
591	            let bytes = try? Data(contentsOf: found.template.url)
592	        else {
593	            throw AutoZoom.Refusal(
594	                message: "The bundled \(templateName) template does not compile.")
595	        }
596	        return (found.template.url, bytes, schema)
597	    }
598	
599	    /// CU-81: a module of `store` whose bytes equal the template's — `keyboard-keys` first,
600	    /// else the lowest name — or nil.
601	    static func reusableModule(in store: GraphicStore, bytes: Data) -> String? {
602	        let same = store.scan.modules.values.filter { $0.bytes == bytes }.map(\.name)
603	        return same.contains(templateName) ? templateName : same.min()
604	    }
605	
606	    /// `plan_overlays`' request JSON for `clips` (container ticks `from`/`to`, nil for none).
607	    static func request(
608	        _ clips: [UInt32], settings: ShortcutOverlaySettings, module: String,
609	        schema: [String: Any], from: Ticks?, to: Ticks?
610	    ) -> String {
611	        var args: [String: Any] = [
612	            "clips": clips.map { Int($0) }, "duration": settings.duration,
613	            "position": settings.position, "theme": settings.theme, "module": module,
614	            "schema": schema,
615	        ]
616	        if let from { args["from"] = from }
617	        if let to { args["to"] = to }
618	        let data =
619	            (try? JSONSerialization.data(withJSONObject: ["plan_overlays": args])) ?? Data()
620	        return String(decoding: data, as: UTF8.self)
621	    }
622	
623	    /// Asks the core for the plan over `clips` of `project` (the edited one, so inside a nest
624	    /// the nest's), one track per clip; throws the core's sentence as a `Refusal`.
625	    static func plan(
626	        _ clips: [ClipSnapshot], tracks: [UInt32: ReelCursor], project: ReelProject,
627	        settings: ShortcutOverlaySettings, module: String, schema: [String: Any],
628	        from: Ticks?, to: Ticks?
629	    ) throws -> ShortcutOverlayPlan {
630	        var ordered: [ReelCursor] = []
631	        for clip in clips {
632	            guard case .media(let id, _, _) = clip.source, let track = tracks[id] else {
633	                throw AutoZoom.Refusal(message: "Clip \(clip.id)'s cursor file was not read.")
634	            }
635	            ordered.append(track)
636	        }
637	        let text: String
638	        do {
639	            text = try ReelCursor.query(
640	                request(
641	                    clips.map(\.id), settings: settings, module: module, schema: schema,
642	                    from: from, to: to),
643	                tracks: ordered, project: project)
644	        } catch {
645	            let reason = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
646	            throw AutoZoom.Refusal(message: AutoZoom.sentence(reason))
647	        }
648	        guard let answer = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(text.utf8))
649	            as? [String: Any]
650	        else { throw AutoZoom.Refusal(message: "The overlays' plan could not be read.") }
651	        let ops = try ((answer["ops"] as? [[String: Any]]) ?? []).map(op)
652	        func count(_ key: String) -> Int { (answer[key] as? NSNumber)?.intValue ?? 0 }
653	        return ShortcutOverlayPlan(
654	            ops: ops, added: count("added"), dropped: count("dropped"),
655	            merged: count("merged"),
656	            track: (answer["track"] as? NSNumber)?.uint32Value ?? 0,
657	            newTrack: (answer["new_track"] as? Bool) ?? false,
658	            overlays: (answer["overlays"] as? [[String: Any]]) ?? [])
659	    }
660	
661	    /// Both doors' run, on main, after the files are read: the module chosen by CU-81, the
662	    /// plan, and — only when the plan places something and no module could be reused — the
663	    /// template written into `graphics/` (not undoable, G-3) and the plan made again when the
664	    /// written name is not the one predicted.
665	    static func prepared(
666	        _ document: ProjectDocument, clips ids: [UInt32], tracks: [UInt32: ReelCursor],
667	        settings: ShortcutOverlaySettings, from: Ticks?, to: Ticks?
668	    ) throws -> (plan: ShortcutOverlayPlan, module: String, written: Bool) {
669	        guard let store = document.graphicStore else {
670	            throw AutoZoom.Refusal(message: ProjectDocument.noGraphicsFolderSentence + ".")
671	        }
672	        let template = try template()
673	        let snapshot = document.editedProject.snapshot
674	        let clips = ids.compactMap { snapshot.clip($0) }
675	        func planned(_ module: String) throws -> ShortcutOverlayPlan {
676	            try plan(
677	                clips, tracks: tracks, project: document.editedProject, settings: settings,
678	                module: module, schema: template.schema, from: from, to: to)
679	        }
680	        if let reused = reusableModule(in: store, bytes: template.bytes) {
681	            return (try planned(reused), reused, false)
682	        }
683	        let predicted = store.uniqueModuleName(templateName)
684	        let first = try planned(predicted)
685	        guard first.added > 0 else { return (first, predicted, false) }
686	        let written: String
687	        do {
688	            written = try document.writeGraphicModule(from: template.url)
689	        } catch {
690	            let reason = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
691	            throw AutoZoom.Refusal(message: AutoZoom.sentence(reason))
692	        }
693	        guard written != predicted else { return (first, written, true) }
694	        return (try planned(written), written, true)
695	    }
696	
697	    /// One op of the answer, through `ReelOps.swift`'s factories.
698	    private static func op(_ o: [String: Any]) throws -> ReelOp {
699	        func ticks(_ key: String) -> Ticks { (o[key] as? NSNumber)?.int64Value ?? 0 }
700	        switch o["op"] as? String {
701	        case "add_track":
702	            return .addTrack(
703	                index: (o["index"] as? NSNumber)?.intValue ?? 0, name: o["name"] as? String)
704	        case "add_graphic_clip":
705	            return .addGraphicClipRaw(
706	                track: (o["track"] as? NSNumber)?.uint32Value ?? 0, at: ticks("at"),
707	                duration: ticks("duration"), name: (o["name"] as? String) ?? "",
708	                props: o["props"], schema: o["schema"])
709	        default:
710	            throw AutoZoom.Refusal(message: "The overlays' plan named an op it does not make.")
711	        }
712	    }
713	}

837	    var rate = 4.0, shortest = 3.0, keepPitch = true
838	
839	    static let rateRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 2...8
840	    static let shortestRange: ClosedRange<Double> = 1...30
841

843	    static let shortestKey = "FrameJobSpeedUpTypingShortest"
844	    static let keepPitchKey = "FrameJobSpeedUpTypingKeepPitch"

846	    /// The remembered values, each clamped into its range; the default for a key not stored.
847	    /// Read through `double(forKey:)` and `bool(forKey:)`, so a launch argument's string
848	    /// (`-FrameJobSpeedUpTypingRate 6`) reads as its number.
849	    static func remembered(_ d: UserDefaults) -> SpeedUpTypingSettings {
850	        var s = SpeedUpTypingSettings()
851	        func number(_ key: String, _ range: ClosedRange<Double>, _ value: inout Double) {
852	            guard d.object(forKey: key) != nil else { return }
853	            let v = d.double(forKey: key)
854	            if v.isFinite, v > 0 { value = min(max(v, range.lowerBound), range.upperBound) }
855	        }
856	        number(rateKey, rateRange, &s.rate)
857	        number(shortestKey, shortestRange, &s.shortest)
858	        if d.object(forKey: keepPitchKey) != nil { s.keepPitch = d.bool(forKey: keepPitchKey) }
859	        return s

862	    /// Writes only the keys whose value differs from `opened`'s, so a sheet whose controls
863	    /// were not changed writes nothing (mcp.py's DEFAULTS MOVED guard).
864	    func remember(changedFrom opened: SpeedUpTypingSettings, in d: UserDefaults) {
865	        if rate != opened.rate { d.set(rate, forKey: Self.rateKey) }
866	        if shortest != opened.shortest { d.set(shortest, forKey: Self.shortestKey) }
867	        if keepPitch != opened.keepPitch { d.set(keepPitch, forKey: Self.keepPitchKey) }
868	    }

924	    ) -> String {

926	            "clips": clips.map { Int($0) }, "rate": settings.rate,

935	    /// The speech step for the media `plan_typing` named in `needs_speech` (CU-93), in order:
936	    /// a media whose `speech` is stored is skipped (AU-111); no file is refused; a current
937	    /// cache (`isCurrent`) that loads becomes a `set_media_speech` op; otherwise pending while
938	    /// detection is `available`, and refused when it is not.
939	    static func speech(
940	        for media: [UInt32], in snapshot: ProjectSnapshot, cacheDirectory: URL?,
941	        available: Bool, isCurrent: (MediaSnapshot) -> Bool
942	    ) -> SpeedUpTypingSpeech {
943	        var ops: [ReelOp] = []
944	        var pending: [String] = []
945	        for id in media {
946	            guard let m = snapshot.media(id), m.speech == nil else { continue }
947	            guard mediaURL(for: m) != nil else {
948	                return .refused("\(m.name) is offline, so its speech cannot be read.")
949	            }
950	            if isCurrent(m), let directory = cacheDirectory,
951	                let p = MediaImporter.loadSpeech(for: id, in: directory)
952	            {
953	                ops.append(.setMediaSpeech(media: id, spans: DuckSpeech.spans(p, duration: m.duration)))
954	            } else if available {
955	                pending.append(m.name)
956	            } else {
957	                return .refused(
958	                    "Speech detection is unavailable on this Mac, so Speed Up Typing cannot "
959	                        + "tell typing from talking.")
960	            }
961	        }
962	        return pending.isEmpty ? .ready(ops) : .pending(pending)
963	    }

966	    static func cacheIsCurrent(_ media: MediaSnapshot, in cacheDirectory: URL?) -> Bool {
967	        guard let cacheDirectory, let url = mediaURL(for: media) else { return false }
968	        let stamp = MediaImporter.CacheStamp.stamp(for: media, url: url)
969	        return MediaImporter.speechIsCurrent(for: media, stamp: stamp, in: cacheDirectory)

972	    /// Plans over `clips` of `project` (the edited one, so inside a nest the nest's), makes the
973	    /// speech ops it asks for, applies them to the pure handle and plans again; throws the
974	    /// core's sentence or the speech step's as a `Refusal`.
975	    static func resolve(
976	        _ clips: [ClipSnapshot], tracks: [UInt32: ReelCursor], project: ReelProject,
977	        cacheDirectory: URL?, settings: SpeedUpTypingSettings, from: Ticks?, to: Ticks?,
978	        available: Bool = SileroVAD.isAvailable
979	    ) throws -> SpeedUpTypingOutcome {
980	        let first = try plan(
981	            clips, tracks: tracks, project: project, settings: settings, from: from, to: to)
982	        guard !first.needs.isEmpty else { return .planned(speechOps: [], plan: first.plan) }
983	        let speechOps: [ReelOp]
984	        switch speech(
985	            for: first.needs, in: project.snapshot, cacheDirectory: cacheDirectory,
986	            available: available, isCurrent: { cacheIsCurrent($0, in: cacheDirectory) })
987	        {
988	        case .refused(let why): throw Refusal(message: why)
989	        case .pending(let names): return .waiting(names)
990	        case .ready(let ops): speechOps = ops
991	        }
992	        guard case .applied(let spoken)? = try? project.applying(speechOps) else {
993	            throw Refusal(message: "The speech spans could not be saved, so nothing was sped up.")
994	        }
995	        let second = try plan(
996	            clips, tracks: tracks, project: spoken, settings: settings, from: from, to: to)
997	        guard second.needs.isEmpty else {
998	            throw Refusal(message: "The speech spans could not be saved, so nothing was sped up.")
999	        }
1000	        return .planned(speechOps: speechOps, plan: second.plan)
1001	    }

1003	    /// Asks the core for the plan, one track per clip; the media it needs speech for, and the
1004	    /// plan (empty while any are needed).
1005	    private static func plan(
1006	        _ clips: [ClipSnapshot], tracks: [UInt32: ReelCursor], project: ReelProject,
1007	        settings: SpeedUpTypingSettings, from: Ticks?, to: Ticks?
1008	    ) throws -> (needs: [UInt32], plan: SpeedUpTypingPlan) {
1009	        var ordered: [ReelCursor] = []
1010	        for clip in clips {
1011	            guard case .media(let id, _, _) = clip.source, let track = tracks[id] else {
1012	                throw Refusal(message: "Clip \(clip.id)'s cursor file was not read.")
1013	            }
1014	            ordered.append(track)
1015	        }
1016	        let text: String
1017	        do {
1018	            text = try ReelCursor.query(
1019	                request(clips.map(\.id), settings: settings, from: from, to: to),
1020	                tracks: ordered, project: project)
1021	        } catch {
1022	            let reason = (error as? ReelCoreError)?.message ?? error.localizedDescription
1023	            throw Refusal(message: AutoZoom.sentence(reason))
1024	        }
1025	        guard let answer = try? JSONSerialization.jsonObject(with: Data(text.utf8))
1026	            as? [String: Any]
1027	        else { throw Refusal(message: "Speed Up Typing's plan could not be read.") }
1028	        func number(_ o: [String: Any], _ key: String) -> Int64 {
1029	            (o[key] as? NSNumber)?.int64Value ?? 0
1030	        }
1031	        let ops = try ((answer["ops"] as? [[String: Any]]) ?? []).map { o -> ReelOp in
1032	            guard o["op"] as? String == "retime_range" else {
1033	                throw Refusal(message: "Speed Up Typing's plan named an op it does not make.")
1034	            }
1035	            return .retimeRange(
1036	                from: number(o, "from"), to: number(o, "to"),
1037	                rate: (o["rate"] as? NSNumber)?.doubleValue ?? settings.rate,
1038	                keepPitch: (o["keep_pitch"] as? Bool) ?? settings.keepPitch)
1039	        }
1040	        let ranges = ((answer["ranges"] as? [[String: Any]]) ?? []).map {
1041	            (from: number($0, "from"), to: number($0, "to"), spedTo: number($0, "sped_to"))
1042	        }
1043	        let needs = ((answer["needs_speech"] as? [NSNumber]) ?? []).map(\.uint32Value)
1044	        return (
1045	            needs,
1046	            SpeedUpTypingPlan(
1047	                ops: ops, stretches: Int(number(answer, "stretches")),
1048	                short: Int(number(answer, "short")), ranges: ranges,
1049	                saved: number(answer, "saved"))
1050	        )
1051	    }

1053	    /// The sheet's summary: what Apply would do, or why it would change nothing.
1054	    static func summary(_ plan: SpeedUpTypingPlan, settings: SpeedUpTypingSettings) -> String {
1055	        guard !plan.ops.isEmpty else {
1056	            return "No typing stretch without speech or a shortcut lasts "
1057	                + "\(plain(settings.shortest)) s or more in the selected clips, so nothing "
1058	                + "would change."
1059	        }
1060	        let n = plan.ops.count
1061	        let stretches = n == 1 ? "1 typing stretch" : "\(n) typing stretches"
1062	        let seconds = String(format: "%.1f", Double(plan.saved) / Double(ReelTime.perSecond))
1063	        return "\(stretches) sped up ×\(plain(settings.rate)), saving \(seconds) s."
1064	    }

1276	        if SpeedUpTyping.gaveUp(waitingFor: elapsed) {
1277	            giveUpTimer?.invalidate()

4	/// A recording's cursor, segment by segment (road map creator-jobs CU1b1, spec §11 CU-11): one
5	/// `CursorCaptureBuffer` per segment, fed while that segment is the current one and closed into
6	/// its file body when the walker reaches it (`ScreenRecorder+Cursor.swift`). PURE — no clock,
7	/// no queue, no file — so `tools/proof/cursor_capture_probe.swift` drives it with synthetic
8	/// polls; its owner (`CursorCapture`) touches it from one queue.
9	///
10	/// **What it adds to the buffer's rules (CU-17).** The poll's dedupe: a polled point is a move
11	/// only when it differs from the last polled one, across segments, and a nil records nothing.
12	/// The seed: a segment opened is fed the last polled point as a move at its open, before its
13	/// anchor, so the buffer keeps it at t 0 and a segment opened after the pointer stopped still
14	/// has its position. Its opening geometry is the last one fed, else the start's. A segment
15	/// `end`ed is fed nothing more and keeps its samples until `close`; a key fed between a pause's
16	/// `end` and the resume's `open` is dropped (spec §11 CU-60).
17	struct CursorSegments {
18	    /// The segment samples go to; nil between a pause's `end` and the resume's `open`.
19	    private(set) var current: Int?
20	    private var buffers: [Int: CursorCaptureBuffer] = [:]
21	    private var lastPoint: CGPoint?
22	    private var lastGeometry: CursorGeometry?
23	
24	    /// Segment `index` opens at `host`: a fresh buffer on `start`, its geometry the last fed,
25	    /// seeded with the last polled point.
26	    mutating func open(_ index: Int, start: CursorSegmentStart, host: Double) {
27	        var buffer = CursorCaptureBuffer()
28	        buffer.openSegment(
29	            CursorSegmentStart(
30	                inPicture: start.inPicture, source: start.source, displayID: start.displayID,
31	                sourceFrame: start.sourceFrame, pointSize: start.pointSize,
32	                pixelsPerPoint: start.pixelsPerPoint, contentSize: start.contentSize,
33	                cursorImage: start.cursorImage, geometry: lastGeometry ?? start.geometry))
34	        if let lastPoint { buffer.move(to: lastPoint, host: host) }
35	        buffers[index] = buffer
36	        current = index
37	    }
38	
39	    /// One poll: a move when the point differs from the last; nil records nothing.
40	    mutating func poll(_ point: CGPoint?, host: Double) {
41	        guard let point, point != lastPoint else { return }
42	        lastPoint = point
43	        guard let current else { return }
44	        buffers[current]?.move(to: point, host: host)
45	    }
46	
47	    mutating func click(button: Int, down: Bool, at point: CGPoint, count: Int, host: Double) {
48	        guard let current else { return }
49	        buffers[current]?.click(button: button, down: down, at: point, count: count, host: host)
50	    }
51	
52	    mutating func scroll(dx: Double, dy: Double, at point: CGPoint, host: Double) {
53	        guard let current else { return }
54	        buffers[current]?.scroll(dx: dx, dy: dy, at: point, host: host)
55	    }
56	
57	    /// A key-down's entry (`CursorKeyFilter`, spec §11 CU-60): a shortcut with its spelled keys
58	    /// and code, or a typed mark with its time alone; `.none` writes nothing.
59	    mutating func key(_ entry: CursorKeyEntry, host: Double) {
60	        guard let current else { return }
61	        switch entry {
62	        case .shortcut(let keys, let code):
63	            buffers[current]?.shortcut(keys: keys, keyCode: code, host: host)
64	        case .typed:
65	            buffers[current]?.typed(host: host)
66	        case .none:
67	            break
68	        }
69	    }
70	
71	    /// The frames' geometry at `host`, remembered for the next segment's open.
72	    mutating func geometry(_ geometry: CursorGeometry, host: Double) {
73	        lastGeometry = geometry
74	        guard let current else { return }
75	        buffers[current]?.geometry(geometry, host: host)
76	    }
77	
78	    /// Segment `index` takes nothing more; its samples wait for `close`.
79	    mutating func end(_ index: Int) {
80	        if current == index { current = nil }
81	    }
82	
83	    /// Segment `index`'s body, its buffer let go; nil when it was never opened.
84	    mutating func close(_ index: Int, movieSize: CursorPixelSize, anchor: CursorAnchor) -> Data? {
85	        end(index)
86	        guard var buffer = buffers.removeValue(forKey: index) else { return nil }
87	        return buffer.closeSegment(movieSize: movieSize, anchor: anchor)
88	    }
89	}

93	/// The modifiers a key-down held that CU-60's rule and spelling read: ⌘, ⌃, ⌥ and ⇧, nothing else
94	/// (⇪ and fn are never part of a shortcut's spelling).
95	struct CursorKeyModifiers: OptionSet, Equatable {
96	    let rawValue: Int
97	    static let cmd = CursorKeyModifiers(rawValue: 1 << 0)
98	    static let ctrl = CursorKeyModifiers(rawValue: 1 << 1)
99	    static let opt = CursorKeyModifiers(rawValue: 1 << 2)
100	    static let shift = CursorKeyModifiers(rawValue: 1 << 3)
101	
102	    init(rawValue: Int) { self.rawValue = rawValue }
103	
104	    /// The four from a `CGEvent`'s flags.
105	    init(flags: CGEventFlags) {
106	        var held: CursorKeyModifiers = []
107	        if flags.contains(.maskCommand) { held.insert(.cmd) }
108	        if flags.contains(.maskControl) { held.insert(.ctrl) }
109	        if flags.contains(.maskAlternate) { held.insert(.opt) }
110	        if flags.contains(.maskShift) { held.insert(.shift) }
111	        self = held
112	    }

115	/// One key-down as the filter sees it. `character` is the layout's character with no modifier
116	/// applied, and it is filled ONLY for a key-down `CursorKeyFilter.isShortcut` calls a shortcut:
117	/// a typed key's character is never read (spec §11 CU-60).
118	struct CursorKeyEvent: Equatable {
119	    var keyCode: Int
120	    var modifiers: CursorKeyModifiers
121	    var isRepeat: Bool
122	    var character: String?
123	}

125	/// What a key-down puts in the cursor file: a spelled shortcut and its key code, a time-only
126	/// typed mark, or nothing.
127	enum CursorKeyEntry: Equatable {
128	    case shortcut(keys: String, code: Int)
129	    case typed
130	    case none

133	/// CU-7 as CU-60 amends it, PURE (road map creator-jobs CU6): which key-down is a shortcut and
134	/// how it is spelled; `CursorCapture+Keys.swift` is the live source that feeds it.
135	///
136	/// **The rule**, in order: secure input held by any process (read at delivery) → nothing, not
137	/// even a time; an auto-repeat → a typed mark; ⌘ or ⌃ held, or ⌥ held with an arrow, Delete,
138	/// Forward Delete, Return, Enter, Tab or Esc (`optionKeyCodes`, the owner's answer of
139	/// 2026-11-01) → a shortcut; anything else → a typed mark. ⇧ alone never makes a shortcut, and
140	/// ⌥ with any other key types a character (⌥E is é), so it is typed.
141	///
142	/// **The spelling**: the held modifiers in the order `cmd`, `ctrl`, `opt`, `shift`, then the
143	/// key — `namedKeys` by its virtual key code, else the character lowercased, `+` spelled `plus`,
144	/// and an empty, whitespace or control character `key<code>` — joined by `+`, so the core's
145	/// check (`cursor_file_check.rs`) accepts every one this writes.
146	enum CursorKeyFilter {
147	    /// ← → ↓ ↑ (123 124 125 126), Delete (51), Forward Delete (117), Return (36), keypad Enter
148	    /// (76), Tab (48) and Esc (53): the keys ⌥ alone makes a shortcut of. Their spellings are
149	    /// the core's `OPTION_SHORTCUT_KEYS`.
150	    static let optionKeyCodes: Set<Int> = [123, 124, 125, 126, 51, 117, 36, 76, 48, 53]
151	
152	    /// The keys spelled by name, by their kVK codes (Carbon's `Events.h`).
153	    static let namedKeys: [Int: String] = [
154	        36: "return", 76: "enter", 48: "tab", 49: "space", 51: "delete", 117: "forwarddelete",
155	        53: "esc", 123: "left", 124: "right", 125: "down", 126: "up", 115: "home", 119: "end",
156	        116: "pageup", 121: "pagedown", 114: "help",
157	        122: "f1", 120: "f2", 99: "f3", 118: "f4", 96: "f5", 97: "f6", 98: "f7", 100: "f8",
158	        101: "f9", 109: "f10", 103: "f11", 111: "f12", 105: "f13", 107: "f14", 113: "f15",
159	        106: "f16", 64: "f17", 79: "f18", 80: "f19", 90: "f20",
160	    ]
161	
162	    /// Whether the key-down is a shortcut: not an auto-repeat, and ⌘ or ⌃ held, or ⌥ held with
163	    /// one of `optionKeyCodes`. The source reads a character only when this is true.
164	    static func isShortcut(_ event: CursorKeyEvent) -> Bool {
165	        guard !event.isRepeat else { return false }
166	        if event.modifiers.contains(.cmd) || event.modifiers.contains(.ctrl) { return true }
167	        return event.modifiers.contains(.opt) && optionKeyCodes.contains(event.keyCode)
168	    }
169	
170	    /// The shortcut's `+`-joined spelling (the type doc).
171	    static func spelled(_ event: CursorKeyEvent) -> String {
172	        var tokens: [String] = []
173	        if event.modifiers.contains(.cmd) { tokens.append("cmd") }
174	        if event.modifiers.contains(.ctrl) { tokens.append("ctrl") }
175	        if event.modifiers.contains(.opt) { tokens.append("opt") }
176	        if event.modifiers.contains(.shift) { tokens.append("shift") }
177	        tokens.append(keyName(event))
178	        return tokens.joined(separator: "+")

181	    /// The key's own token: its name, else its character, else `key<code>`.
182	    private static func keyName(_ event: CursorKeyEvent) -> String {
183	        if let name = namedKeys[event.keyCode] { return name }
184	        let character = (event.character ?? "").lowercased()
185	        let plain =
186	            !character.isEmpty
187	            && character.unicodeScalars.allSatisfy { scalar in
188	                !scalar.properties.isWhitespace
189	                    && scalar.properties.generalCategory != .control
190	                    && scalar.properties.generalCategory != .format
191	            }
192	        guard plain else { return "key\(event.keyCode)" }
193	        return character.replacingOccurrences(of: "+", with: "plus")
194	    }

197	    static func entry(for event: CursorKeyEvent, secure: Bool) -> CursorKeyEntry {
198	        if secure { return .none }
199	        if event.isRepeat { return .typed }
200	        guard isShortcut(event) else { return .typed }
201	        return .shortcut(keys: spelled(event), code: event.keyCode)
202	    }

Valid JSON (json.tool passes). All 191 evidence anchors resolved to file:line against app/Sources, but anchors only prove the cited line exists, not each claim. Nothing was checked by running the app: the framejob MCP server failed to connect, so every record comes from reading code.

Incident: I overwrote gen/build.py in the shared scratchpad folder inventory/gen/. It belonged to the sibling code-history lens. I restored its exact 2,338-character content from that agent's recorded Write call, reading its transcript under the session's subagents folder to do so. Its file size matches. That lens had already run it about 45 s earlier, but raw/code-history.json did not exist when I last listed raw/, so it may need to run build.py with --write. If it ran build.py during the short window while mine was in place, it would have rebuilt my output instead of its own and would need to re-run. Its build imports every gen/r*.py, so it may have loaded my rec1.py (harmless: it adds nothing to core.RECORDS). My files now live in inventory/gen-code-recording/, and I deleted the rec1 .pyc from gen/__pycache__.

Not covered or thin:
- Spec section 11 and the ADRs were not consulted, by design.
- Read only in part: ScreenRecorder finishing and error paths, RecordingLanding internals and the core's cursor_zoom planner, so fine limits there come from file docs and tool descriptions.
- Make Vertical's follow: cursor and its layout re-lay are left to the framing lens, apart from one detail on the Side by Side record.
- Enhance Voice and Remove Background themselves are covered only as landing steps.
- Retime Range is covered only as the op Speed Up Typing uses.

Doc-relevant finding: no cursor images are recorded today (cursor_image is none), so the Style option As recorded draws Frame Job's arrow in practice.

Overlap: expect duplicates with guide-screen-recording, code-mcp-catalog, code-menus and code-sheets. Tool-only arguments are recorded under area mcp; camera layout under framing; Speed Up Typing under speed.
